Prices are never stored here: they come only from the Store server's offers. See docs/CATALOGUE.md before editing. Run `npm run validate:catalogue` after every change.

products.name: HCG Mail
products.summary: A multi-platform email client for existing IMAP and SMTP mailboxes, with secure credential storage and remote content blocked by default.
description: HCG Mail connects to existing mailboxes over standard IMAP and SMTP. It does not need Outlook, Microsoft 365, Exchange or an HCG account.
Connections are encrypted, passwords are kept in the operating system's secure credential store, and remote content in messages is blocked by default.

products.name: HCG Executable Maker
products.summary: Import a project, inspect it without running its code, build it with the real toolchain and package it with SHA-256 checksums.
description: HCG Executable Maker imports a project as a ZIP archive or folder and inspects it statically, without executing any of its code. It then builds the project with the real toolchain, packages it for distribution and records SHA-256 checksums for every artifact.

.NET projects, including Avalonia desktop apps, can be built and packaged for Windows (portable or Setup.exe installer), macOS and Linux (portable preview). Android and iOS projects are handled by Mobile Build Studio when the required toolchains are present.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.3.0 is a pre-release. The development repository's CI packages macOS, Windows and Linux builds; none has been supplied to HCG Store as an approved release.

products.name: HCG RePrompter
products.summary: A native macOS prompt-engineering workstation that clarifies instructions for AI systems without changing their intent.
description: HCG RePrompter turns incomplete or unstructured prompts into clearer, better-organised instructions for AI systems. It preserves the user's meaning, requirements and constraints, and explains every change instead of assigning an arbitrary score.
It works with the user's own Anthropic API key and includes a deterministic, offline Local Formatting mode that is always labelled as non-AI.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.1.0 is a pre-release development build and has not been commercially released.
catalogueNotes: The HCG Development Tools classification is provisional and awaits founder confirmation.

products.name: HCG CardX
products.summary: A native iOS marketplace app with listings, seller storefronts and HCG account sign-in.
description: HCG CardX is a native iOS marketplace app. It includes a public listing feed, seller storefronts and photo uploads for listings.
It signs in with the shared HCG identity. Marketplace operations are authorised by the HCG backend, not by the app.
products.developmentNote: Reported as in progress in the founder's 31 October 2026 objectives.

products.name: HCG Terminal
products.summary: A native SwiftUI terminal for iPhone and iPad: local commands, remote SSH development, remote builds and tests, logs and artifacts.
description: HCG Terminal is a native SwiftUI terminal for iPhone and iPad by Hakmi Capital Group. It covers local commands, remote SSH development, remote Swift, Xcode and .NET builds and tests, logs and artifacts.

It comes in two separately built editions. The standard edition runs built-in commands in the app's own workspace. HCG Terminal Unleashed is a separate jailbreak build that runs a real shell in a pseudo-terminal, only where the device already allows it.

products.name: HCG Nexus
products.summary: An HCG command panel with searchable shortcuts, workspaces, recent actions, HCG integration status and settings.
description: HCG Nexus is a command panel with searchable shortcuts, workspaces, recent actions, HCG integration status and settings.

It is built in two separate forms that never share data: a sandboxed iPhone and iPad app, and a jailbreak package that adds a system-wide edge handle over any app. The jailbreak package is off after installation until it is enabled in Settings.

products.name: HCG Sentinel
products.summary: A native iPhone and iPad app for authorised testing of your own devices, networks and services.
description: HCG Sentinel is a native SwiftUI app for iPhone and iPad for authorised testing of your own devices, networks and services: capture-file inspection, Bluetooth LE discovery, a controlled test-request composer, and a client for an external radio-analysis node.
Each capability is tracked separately as implemented, supported on the device, enabled by you and verified by a real operation. Fabricated data appears only in a clearly labelled Preview mode.
products.developmentNote: Version 0.1.0 (build 1). Not tested on physical devices. App Store upload and package publishing are not scripted.

It runs as a local web app and as an Electron desktop app for macOS.
